verdict.rationale: The SDK supports session persistence and forking (sessions.md) but there is no evidence of versioning automations (agent configs/workflows) with diffs, review workflows, or rollback of automation logic itself — sessions are conversation history, not automation version control. missing for 10: version control/diff tracking for agent/automation definitions, a review or approval workflow for changes, and a rollback mechanism for automation configurations (not just conversation session forking).
